'''Fire giants''' may be encountered while training [[Dungeoneering]]. Unlike normal Fire giants, these giants' combat levels can be very high. They are first found on the [[Dungeoneering floors#Occult floors (m)|Occult floors]]. They hit very hard with melee, so [[Protect from Melee]] or [[Deflect Melee]] is recommended when at close quarters. However, their large size means they can be easily trapped by using [[safespot]]s; though as with all monsters in [[Daemonheim]], they will wander if unable to attack their opponent.
